_comment: ECUMaster CAN Switch Board V3 (CSB3) frames on the shared 1 Mbit/s CAN1 bus. Split out of link_g4x_can_setup.json (decision D1, 2026-10-02): that file stays the ECU broadcast contract; this one holds the switchboard's own frames. Layout source: ECUMaster CAN Switch Board V3 manual v2.1 (FW 3.0+), sections 5-6; mirrored in CAN-BUS-ID-ALLOCATION-TABLE.md section 5 and bench/frames.py. Scale/offset here use the DECODE convention (value = raw * scale + offset), like the .lcs, the ID table and frames.py. The cluster does not decode any of these frames; RealDash does not read them. bench/check_parity.py checks this file against frames.py and the ID table.
manual: CAN Switch Board V3 user manual, document v2.1, firmware 3.0 or later (03 Dec 2024)
cycle_wording: 0x640-0x642: periodic, switchboard 'CAN send rate' (default 20 Hz = 50 ms). 0x643: periodic 50 ms PCLink CAN TX stream from the ECU; the bytes only change when the ECU changes an output. The manual sets no required rate for 0x643.

channels.name: Analog Input 1
channels.assignment: Unassigned (was cabin temp; A/C belongs to the OEM amplifier, 2026-09-27)

channels.name: Analog Input 2
channels.assignment: OEM cruise stalk resistor ladder (ECUMASTER_SWITCHBOARD_SETUP.md Step 4.1)

frames.name: Rotary / Switch / Analog State / Low-Side State / Heartbeat

channels.name: AS_MASK
channels.note: bit N = Analog State N+1 (per manual: 0 below 2 V, 1 above 3 V)

channels.name: LS_MASK
channels.note: bits 0-3 = state of low-side outputs L1-L4

frames.name: Low-Side Output Control
frames._comment: Source = ECU (PCLink CAN TX stream), decided 2026-06-14. The cluster never transmits 0x643. Outputs L1-L4 are currently unused (LED-only if ever used). Manual: DLC >= 4, byte N = L(N+1) ctrl, bytes 4-7 = 0.
